entities.summary: Abū Muḥammad al-Qāsim ibn Fīrruh ibn Khalaf ibn Aḥmad al-Ruʿaynī al-Shāṭibī, 538–590 AH / 1144–1194 CE, was an Islamic scholar from Xàtiva who worked in the field of qira'at, Qur'an recitation methods.
